claims: St. John's University is a private Catholic university.
St. John's University is primarily located in Queens, New York.
The main campus of St. John's University is a 102-acre residential campus.
The main campus of St. John's University is at 8000 Utopia Parkway in Hillcrest, NY.
St. John's University has additional campus locations in Manhattan.
St. John's University has additional campus locations in Staten Island.
St. John's University has international locations.
The Main Campus (Queens) of St. John's University is located at 8000 Utopia Parkway, Queens, NY.
The Manhattan Campus of St. John's University is located at 101 Astor Place.
The Manhattan Campus of St. John's University serves as a hub for specialized programs.
The Staten Island Campus of St. John's University is located at 300 Howard Avenue.
St. John's University maintains locations in Rome, Italy.
St. John's University maintains locations in Paris, France.
Saint John's University for men is a different institution.
Saint John's University for men is located in Collegeville, MN.
